name: Capacities
description: Capacities brings together connected note-taking and structured data so everything you care about becomes an object, whether it’s a person, a book you’re reading, a project you’re working on or an idea you want to explore. Objects have structure, properties and connections that grow into a living network of your thoughts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Capacities to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Capacities to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.capacities.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Capacities MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Capacities lists 14 MCP tools, including appendMDToObject, createObjectLink, createObjectViaMD, createPage, createTask, getObjectContent, getObjectTypeShape, saveToDailyNote, search, updateObjectViaMD, listObjectsByObjectType, and listObjectsByTag.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Capacities?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Capacities in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Capacities requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Capacities is developed by Capacities Labs GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
